capabilities: Browse Bitiful buckets and folders in a sidebar
Upload files by drag-and-drop or paste with automatic image compression and watermarking
Insert Markdown or HTML links to stored files into notes
View bucket capacity statistics and image EXIF data
Rename, move, copy, and delete remote files, including cross-bucket replication
extras: README is mostly in Chinese. It states the plugin is a third-party work not affiliated with Bitiful, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author accepts donations.
motivation: The author positions Bitiful as an image host for Obsidian because it offers 50GB free storage, an S3-compatible API, and fast access from China.
problem: Obsidian keeps attachments in the local vault, so users who host images and files on cloud storage have no built-in way to browse, upload, or link them.

relations.evidence: A plugin for managing Bitiful cloud storage in Obsidian.

requires.name: S3 Access Key and Secret Key

summary: Cloud storage manager for Bitiful that browses buckets, uploads files, compresses and watermarks images, and inserts links into notes.
